title: Fifth Attack - Scroll-Learned Passive Attack
body:
Syntax: READ A SCROLL OF FIFTH ATTACK | PRAC FIFTH ATTACK

Level required: 90 for Bukijutsu only.
How learned: SCROLL ONLY (object VNUM 31743, Scroll Jutsu area 31501-32000). Not granted on level-up or login. Characters who learned it in previous releases keep their mastery.
Effect: A fifth melee swing, attempted only after Second, Third and Fourth Attack succeed. It activates during normal melee combat without a command or Chakra charge. This attack uses its own proficiency as its activation chance; a failed attack roll stops all later numbered attacks that round.
After learning, use PRAC FIFTH ATTACK with a teacher, then improve proficiency through successful combat use. New readers start at 0% mastery. A successful READ consumes the scroll; failed, underlevel, class-ineligible or already-known reads do not consume it.
